attempted_claim: A verified 250-row distinguishing table (label, DT code, Jones polynomial, hyperbolic volume or non-hyperbolic tag, Khovanov delta-width) for prime knots through 10 crossings computed from DT codes with Kauffman-bracket recursion double-checked by state-sum enumeration, triangulation volumes matching published values within 1e-4, plus (i) chiral separation: 3_1 vs mirror (and 5_2 vs mirror) with V_K(t)!=V_K(t^-1) but equal volumes/tags, and (ii) same-Jones separation: an in-census Jones collision separated by volume or width, plus Conway 11n34 vs Kinoshita-Terasaka 11n42 with identical Jones and equal volumes but different delta-width/support, each with diagram PNG and one-command replay.

decisive_failure: originality: Nearest priors substantively anticipate all mathematical facts. KnotAtlas/KnotTheory (precomputed PD4Knots/Jones4Knots, IndianaData, DTCode data) already publishes for every row the same PD, DT, Jones, hyperbolic volume/tag, Khovanov (r,j) support and 'Similar Knots' lists. Live pages verify: 5_1 page lists Same Jones (up to mirror) {10_132} and Same Alexander {10_132}; 10_132 page lists Same {5_1}; Jones/volume/Khovanov values identical to candidate's table. Candidate's Jones values match oracle exactly by design (calibrated on 3_1/4_1/5_2 then required to match), method is textbook Kauffman bracket state sum (Kauffman 1987), and volume/width columns are parsed — not recomputed — oracle values with trivial delta formula. The 7 collision classes and 5_1/10_132 separation (same Jones, different volume/support) are thus database joins, not new discoveries. Hoste-Thistlethwaite-Weeks (1.7M knots through 16 crossings) anticipates DT+volume census; Wehrli (math/0301312) and Morton-Ryder (0708.0514) anticipate same-Jones/different-Khovanov mutant phenomena. Claimed delta of 'joint replayable table with logs' is curation/verification engineering, not a new object, theorem, or value. A timestamp or internal prior-scan PASS does not establish priority. value: Not independently worth finding later. Correct but textbook restatement: standard bracket enumeration applied to known census reproducing KnotAtlas exactly, joined with published volume and support-width columns. No new invariant value, no new collision (all 7 pre-listed in oracle), no Conway/KT mutant separation (explicitly not computed), no triangulation volume, no Bar-Natan homology (torsion/differentials unverified, reduced-vs-unreduced unaddressed, w=3-vs-2 convention relabeling). Star witness 5_1 (torus, non-hyperbolic) vs 10_132 (hyperbolic, wide) is readable directly from oracle pages; six other pairs are same-width volume differences only. Teaching-dataset/replay-benchmark utility does not meet publishable-research bar and falls under rejected categories: textbook restatement, database quotation with verification, and unexplained enumeration.

method_summary: Kauffman-bracket skein evaluation with ideal-triangulation hyperbolic-volume cross-check and width computation plus diagram replay
problem_statement: From standard minimal Dowker-Thistlethwaite codes for all 250 prime diagrams through 10 crossings (0_1 plus 3_1 through 10_165), compute: (a) Jones polynomial V(t) by memoized Kauffman-bracket skein recursion from PD codes derived from DT, with independent brute-force 2^n state-sum recheck requiring exact match; (b) hyperbolic volume by ideal-triangulation decomposition (octahedra at crossings, simplification, gluing-equation solve) with cross-check against published volumes within 1e-4 where hyperbolic and non-hyperbolic tag for 0_1,3_1,5_1,7_1,8_19,9_1,10_124; (c) Khovanov delta-width w=max(j-2i)-min(j-2i)+1 from reduced homology over Q with logged chain dimensions and (i,j) support. Publish table (label, DT, Jones, volume-or-tag, w) plus diagrams and replay scripts, with chirality witness (3_1 vs mirror and 5_2 vs mirror: Jones mirror-asymmetry, volume equality) and same-Jones witness (in-census collision if found, plus Conway 11n34 vs KT 11n42 extension: exact Jones equality, volume equality within tolerance, width difference). Pass requires full 250-row table, two-method Jones agreement, volume cross-check, and at least one clean separation of each type.
